# {{ site.name }}

> {{ site.description | strip }}

Ryan Spletzer is a Distinguished Engineer at Autodesk.
This site is his personal blog. All posts are written by Ryan and
licensed CC BY 4.0.

Every post is a single HTML page at a stable URL of the form
`{{ site.url }}/YYYY/MM/slug/`. Posts are listed newest first.

## Pages

- [About]({{ site.url }}/about/): Bio, career history, and areas of interest
